question: Who among the following boxers won the women's lightweight gold medal at the 2022 Commonwealth Games in Birmingham and received the BBC Emerging Player of the Year Award?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nitu Ghanghas.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nitu Ghanghas won the women's lightweight gold medal at the 2022 Commonwealth Games in Birmingham and received the BBC Emerging Player of the Year Award.**
 
• Nikhat Zareen is an Indian female boxer who won a gold medal at the 2011 Asian Youth Boxing Championship and a bronze medal at the 2019 AIBA Women's World Boxing Championships.
 
• **Lovlina Borgohain is also an Indian female boxer who won a bronze medal at the 2020 Tokyo Olympics in the women's welterweight category.**
 
• Saweety Boora is an Indian female boxer who won a silver medal at the 2014 Commonwealth Games in Glasgow and a bronze medal at the 2018 AIBA Women's World Boxing Championships.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Women's lightweight boxing category has a weight limit of 60 kg (132 lbs).**
 
• **The 2022 Commonwealth Games were held in Birmingham, England from 28 July to 8 August 2022.**
 
• BBC Emerging Player of the Year Award is given to a young athlete who shows exceptional performance and potential for the future.
 
• Nitu Ghanghas was awarded this in recognition of her achievements in the Commonwealth Games.
